title: Acts Bible Quiz - Chapter 22
description: Ten questions on Acts 22: Paul's defense on the stairs, the light near Damascus, and the question of his Roman citizenship.

questions.text: At whose feet did Paul say he was brought up in Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Paul said he was born in Tarsus of Cilicia but brought up in this city at the feet of Gamaliel.

answers.text: Ananias
The high priest
Gamaliel
Stephen

questions.text: What did Paul say he had done to this Way?
questions.explanation: He said he persecuted this Way to the death, binding and delivering into prisons both men and women.

answers.text: He persecuted it to the death, imprisoning both men and women
He defended it before the council of the elders
He taught it secretly in the synagogues
He had never heard of it until Damascus

questions.text: When did the great light shine around Paul on his journey, and where did it come from?
questions.explanation: As he came close to Damascus, about noon, a great light suddenly shone around him from the sky.

answers.text: At midnight, out of the temple
At dawn, from a pillar of fire
In the evening, from an angel's face
About noon, from the sky

questions.text: Who did the voice say that it was?
questions.explanation: When Paul asked who he was, the voice said, "I am Jesus of Nazareth, whom you persecute."

answers.text: The God of our fathers
Jesus of Nazareth
The Spirit of the Lord
An angel of the Lord

questions.text: What did the Lord tell Paul to do when he asked, "What shall I do, Lord?"
questions.explanation: The Lord told him to arise and go into Damascus, where he would be told about all the things appointed for him to do.

answers.text: To arise and go into Damascus, where he would be told what to do
To return to Jerusalem and to keep silent there
To go at once to the Gentiles who were far away
To wait on the road until a guide should come

questions.text: Who came to Paul in Damascus, and what did he say to him?
questions.explanation: Ananias, a devout man according to the law, stood by him and said, "Brother Saul, receive your sight!"

answers.text: Gamaliel, who said he should keep the law
The high priest, who took back his letters
Ananias, who said, "Brother Saul, receive your sight!"
Agabus, who said he would be bound

questions.text: What did Ananias tell Paul to do without waiting?
questions.explanation: He said, "Arise, be baptized, and wash away your sins, calling on the name of the Lord."

answers.text: To fast and to pray for three days in that house
To arise, be baptized, and wash away his sins
To go back to Jerusalem and testify in the temple
To keep the strict tradition of the fathers' law

questions.text: What did Paul hear while he prayed in the temple at Jerusalem and fell into a trance?
questions.explanation: He saw him saying to hurry and get out of Jerusalem quickly, because they would not receive his testimony about him.

answers.text: That he would be a witness before kings
That he should stay and teach in the temple
That an angel would lead him to Caesarea
To hurry and get out of Jerusalem quickly

questions.text: What did the crowd cry out when Paul said he was sent far away to the Gentiles?
questions.explanation: They lifted up their voice and said that he should be rid from the earth, for he was not fit to live.

answers.text: Rid the earth of this fellow, for he isn't fit to live
Away with him to the high priest and the council
Great is the law of our fathers and of Moses
Let him speak to us again about this matter

questions.text: What did the commanding officer say about his own citizenship, and what did Paul answer?
questions.explanation: The officer said he had bought his citizenship for a great price, and Paul said that he was born a Roman.

answers.text: He had received it from Caesar, while Paul had bought his
He had been born a Roman, while Paul had bought his
He had bought it for a great price, while Paul was born a Roman
He had no citizenship, and neither did Paul
